By the Law of Cosines at \(B\):
\[
6^2=7^2+5^2-2(7)(5)\cos \angle ABC
\]
\[
36=74-70\cos \angle ABC \implies \cos \angle ABC=\frac{38}{70}=\frac{19}{35}.
\]
Since the angle between \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) and \(\overrightarrow{BC}\) is supplementary to \(\angle ABC\):
\[
\overrightarrow{AB}\cdot \overrightarrow{BC}=7\cdot 5\cdot (-\cos \angle ABC)
=35\left(-\frac{19}{35}\right)=-19.
\]
\[
\boxed{-19}
\]
